programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.

programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.

programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.

programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.

programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.

programs.label: OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome: LMI + purchase-price review
programs.sourceLabel: OHCS FirstHome county targeted/non-targeted purchase-price limits and FFIEC LMI tract context
programs.disclosure: OHCS FirstHome review requires the saved Oregon listing to match the configured FFIEC LMI tract context and the applicable targeted or non-targeted OHCS purchase-price limit. It does not determine borrower, property, program, lender, underwriting, or approval eligibility.

programs.label: FHFA 2026: county listing-price review
programs.disclosure: FHFA county review is a 2026 listed-price context only. It is not a loan amount, property eligibility, borrower qualification, rate, or approval decision.

programs.label: CalHFA MyHome: property context review
programs.disclosure: CalHFA MyHome property context is limited to California one-unit listing categories published by CalHFA. It has no general sales-price cap and does not determine income, first-time status, occupancy, counseling, lender approval, or eligibility.

programs.label: Idaho Housing: Tax-Exempt/MRB price review
programs.shortLabel: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB county price reviewed
programs.disclosure: Idaho Housing Tax-Exempt/MRB review uses the authorized 2026 county listed-price chart only. It does not verify income, first-time status, targeted-area qualification, property eligibility, occupancy, lender requirements, underwriting, or approval.

programs.label: Lakeview National: Oregon + Washington review screen
programs.sourceLabel: FHFA 2026 county values and GeoSphere review policy
programs.disclosure: Lakeview National is a listing-review screen only. It does not verify income, credit, AUS, DTI, LTV/CLTV, occupancy, program availability, property eligibility, or underwriting.
